label: Facebook Ads Scraper
title: Facebook Ads Scraper: Ad Library Creatives & Targeting
metaDescription: Extract Facebook Ad Library data: ad creatives, copy, media URLs, targeting and reach. Search by keyword, page or Ad Library link.
intro: Search the Meta Ad Library by keyword, page or Ad Library link and get each ad's creatives, copy, media URLs, dates, platforms and page details; switch on enrichment for the targeting and reach data Meta publishes.
useCases: See every ad a competitor is running, and since when
Collect winning ad copy and creatives in a niche
Track political and issue ads for research

faq.q: How do I search the Meta Ad Library in bulk?
faq.a: Give it keywords, advertiser names or page IDs, or paste Ad Library links with your filters; each returns the matching ads with creatives, copy, dates and platforms.

faq.q: Can I see an ad's targeting and reach?
faq.a: For ads shown in the EU, yes: location audience, age and gender breakdown, total EU reach, and who paid for and benefits from the ad, as Meta publishes it.

faq.q: Can I get only active ads, or only videos?
faq.a: Yes. Filter by active status, ad type, media type, country and language, and sort by total impressions or date.

faq.q: Is there a limit on the free plan?
faq.a: On a free Apify plan a run returns at most 200 ads in total (a sample); on a paid plan there is no limit. The run detects the plan by itself.

faq.q: Do I need a Facebook account?
faq.a: No. The Ad Library is public; no login or cookies.

officialApi: Meta's Ad Library API needs a verified identity and a developer app, and for most countries returns only political and social-issue ads. This actor returns every ad type the public Ad Library shows, with no app or token.
